docker-mcp-gateway: init at v0.36.0

Adds the Docker MCP Gateway CLI plugin, which enables Docker to manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. This tool acts as a gateway allowing AI applications to connect to external data sources and tools through the standardized MCP protocol.

The package provides both a Docker CLI plugin (docker mcp) and a standalone binary (docker-mcp), with support for:

  • MCP server and client management
  • Secret management and OAuth authentication flows
  • Server catalog management
  • Secure access to services through Docker containers
